name: Nebesnyj lycar Ole!
source:
Have you ever heard of the Heavenly World? Where two kingdoms rule, and where the unfortunate Prince and Princess live with their servants? 

After the lovers' ill-fated escape attempt, the Moon Princess sends her faithful knight on a deadly mission, but also allows him a moment to finish up his own affairs.

A celestial servant named Ole would like to leave a memory of himself in this world, and to do so, he needs a human who can write a legend about him. Or maybe...someone not so human? Ole descends to earth to face the first inhabitant he meets... 

[Translated from [url=https://plyih.itch.io/skyknightole]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你听说过天堂世界吗？两个王国统治的地方，不幸的王子和公主与他们的仆人住在一起的地方？

在这对恋人不幸逃脱之后，月亮公主派她忠实的骑士执行一项致命的任务，但也给了他一些时间来完成自己的事务。

一位名叫奥莱的天仆想要在这个世界上留下自己的记忆，为此，他需要一个能够为他谱写传奇的人类。或者也许……一个不那么人类的人？奥莱降临地球，面对他遇到的第一个居民…… 

[译自[url=https://plyih.itch.io/skyknightole]itch.io[/url]]
